title: PRadR 2 - A single center, open-label, Phase I study evaluating 161Tb-PSMA therapy in adult patients with metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma
official: PRadR 2 - A single center, open-label, Phase I study evaluating 161Tb-PSMA therapy in adult patients with metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma
summary: Main objective: To determine the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and the recommended dose for extension (RP2D) of 161TbPSMA in metastatic ccRCC
conditions: Metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. I1. Male or female patients aged ≥ 18 years at time of informed consent signature.
2. I9. Fertile males must use a highly effective contraception during dosing period and  through 6 months after final administration of study.
3. I11.  Patient should understand, sign, and date the written voluntary informed consent form  at the screening visit prior to any protocol-specific procedures performed.
4. I12.  Covered by a medical insurance.
5. I10. Patient should be able and willing to comply with study visits and procedures as  per protocol.
6. I2. Patient with histologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic clear cell renal cell  carcinoma (mccRCC) progressing during or after at least 2 lines of therapy including  at least 1 line of anti-VEGFR and 1 line of immunotherapy.
7. I3. Patient with documented radiological disease progression at the time of inclusion  with measurable disease as per RECIST v1.1.
8. I4. Patient with positive PSMA-PET (68Ga-PSMA-PET) (see Appendix 6):  o For patient with only extrahepatic disease: ≥ 50% of positive extrahepatic lesions  o For patient with both extra-hepatic and liver metastasis: ≥ 50% of positive  extrahepatic metastatic lesions and ≥ 80 % of positive supracentimetric liver  metastatic lesions.  o For patient with only liver metastatic lesions:  ≥ 80 % of positive supracentimetric  lesions
9. I5. Life expectancy ≥ 6 months.
10. I6. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) 0-1, with a  Karnofsky Performance Status (KPS) ≥ 80%.
11. I7. Adequate organ function according to laboratory values defined below : See table in inclusion criteria
12. I8. Women of child-bearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test at screening  (within 72 hours prior C1D1) and must agree to use 1 highly effective form of contraception  from the time of the treatment period and of the negative pregnancy test up to 6  months after the last administration of IMP. Effective forms of contraception are  listed in Appendix 5.
Exclusion criteria:
1. E1. Patients with known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or epidural  metastases and/or leptomeningitis. Patients with previously treated brain metastases may  participate provided they are stable (without evidence of progression by imaging for at least  four weeks prior to C1D1 and any neurologic symptoms have returned to baseline), have  no evidence of new or enlarging brain metastases, and are not using steroids (at doses higher  than 10 mg/d of methylprednisolone or equivalent) for at least 4 weeks prior to C1D1.
2. E2. Patients previously treated with any radiopharmaceutical.
3. E3. Persisting AEs related to previous anti-cancer therapy which were not resolved to grade ≤  1 (except: anemia provided that criterion I7 is met) and /or any persistent immune-related  AEs >1 (except adequately controlled irAE, e.g.:  with replacement therapy for endocrine  irAE).
4. E4. History, within 2 years, of cancer other than renal cancer, except for basal or squamous cellcarcinoma of the skin, in situ carcinoma of the cervix or localized prostate cancer.
5. E5. History of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, non-infectious pneumonitis, interstitial lung  disease that required steroids or has current pneumonitis, interstitial lung disease, drug induced pneumonitis, or evidence of active pneumonitis.
6. E6. Prior therapy or needs to be treated with a forbidden concomitant/concurrent  therapies/procedures including: see table in exclusion criteria
7. E7. Patients with clinically significant hematuria, hematemesis or hemoptysis exceeding 0.5  teaspoon (2.5mL) of red blood, as well as those with a history of coagulopathy or other  significant bleeding (e.g., pulmonary hemorrhage) within the 3 months prior to the initiation  of the study treatment. Patients receiving anticoagulation medication will be eligible only  if the dosage and route of administration have remained stable for at least 2 weeks prior to  C1D1.
8. E8. Patients with an active uncontrolled infection.
9. E9. Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
